## Differs

- **2.1.3** (§2) — STILL DIFFERS BY ONE ISOFORM, AND IT IS THE SAME THRESHOLD DRIFT THE PRIOR VALUE DIAGNOSED, NOW ON A DIFFERENT CELL TYPE. From the run's emission table: isoforms analysed 162,800 EXACT; MOST significant in a cell type 35,336 EXACT; NMD susceptible shares 90.87 and 91.96, rounding to the published 90.9 and 92.0. FEWEST significant 24,804 against the published 24,803 -- the only value that differs, and by one. SUPERSEDED, NOT DELETED: the 2026-07-30 value recorded 'the LAE count is 35,335, NOT the published 35,336' with the reason -- a count defined by lfsr < 0.05 is a step function of a quantity the in-Rmd mashr drifts at machine epsilon, so an isoform within 1e-6 of the threshold changes side between runs, and it listed the other three as AT2 24,847, FB 24,803, MV 27,834. On this run the maximum is exact and the MINIMUM has moved by one instead. That is the predicted behaviour of the mechanism already on file, not a new defect: the same +/-1 flip, relocated. A verdict that keeps moving by one between runs is evidence about the threshold, not about the paper.
- **3.3.2** (§3) — DIFFERS AND DOES NOT RECONCILE. Level-dominated 86.17% and composition-dominated 13.52% against the published 87.4% / 12.6% -- a 1.2 point gap. It is NOT the unclassified bucket: those two sum to 99.69, leaving 0.31% in neither, and renormalising to exclude it gives 86.44 / 13.56, still not 87.4 / 12.6. productive_response.Rmd::kitagawa-on-all, 2026-08-08.
- **3.3.6** (§3) — DIFFERS BY 0.2 POINTS. Composition-dominated 32.08% of significant productive-down NMD genes against the published 31.9%, level-dominated 67.86% against 68.1%. Small but outside rounding: 32.08 rounds to 32.1, not 31.9. productive_response.Rmd::kitagawa-proof, 2026-08-08.
- **3.4.5** (§3) — BOTH ORs DIFFER, AND THE CORRECTION MOVED AWAY FROM THE DATA. Measured DNA replication OR 2.12 and DNA repair OR 1.57, against the published 2.5 and 2.0. The PREVIOUS version of this sentence quoted a single 'DNA replication and repair (OR 2.1)' -- and 2.1 matches the measured replication OR almost exactly. Splitting it into 2.5 and 2.0 replaced one approximately-right number with two that are not supported. Where 2.5 and 2.0 came from is worth establishing before restating. Fisher p for replication 9.28e-07, within the stated p<1e-3. productive_response.Rmd::down-arm-mechanism, 2026-08-08.
- **4.4.6** (§4) — THE MECHANISM SPLIT NOW REPRODUCES EXACTLY and the SE share is a DIFFERENT SENTENCE'S PROBLEM. Run gives 26 frameshift / 18 in-frame stop / 4 3'UTR splice, shares 54.17 / 37.5 / 8.33 -- the published 26/18/4 = 54/38/8%, exact. The SE share is 24 of 48 = 50.0% against this sentence's 47.9%, and the Fisher p is 1.68e-07 against its 7e-7. NOT a moved pair: claim 4.6.2 states the SAME Panel E statistic as 50% / 14% / p<1e-6 and the run satisfies all three, so the paper carries two sentences for one quantity and they disagree with each other. A5SS 12.5% / 4.0% and Alt TES 4.2% / 26.2% both hold.

Each claim above carries the rebuilt value that differs. The per-value causes and the
manuscript sentences behind them are maintained in the working repository and are not
part of this package.

## Partly measured

- **1.1.2** — 'centered near 2.5 kb' REPRODUCES: median isoform length 2,576 nt (2.58 kb), mean 2,896 nt, over the 162,800 universe. The modal 100-nt bin is 1,800-1,900 nt, so 'centered' matches the median, not the mode. 'unimodal' and 'minimal variation across cell types or treatments' NOT MEASURED
- **3.1.4** — MEDIAN REPRODUCES, THE IQR IS UNDERSTATED. Per-isoform percent lost medians 60.16 (MV) to 67.14 (LAE) against the published 'median 60-67%' -- exact. But 'IQR 30-100%' does not bound the four cell types: Q1 runs 25.73 (MV) to 31.63 (LAE), and Q3 runs 96.20 (MV) to 100. So the lower quartile reaches 25.7, not 30, and MV's upper quartile is 96.2, not 100. transcriptional_output.Rmd::boxplot-isoform, 2026-08-08.
- **3.4.2** — ONE OR REPRODUCES, ONE DOES NOT. SR/hnRNP factors OR 6.76 rounds to the published 6.8 -- exact. RNA splicing OR 2.52 against the published 2.6, which rounds to 2.5. Both p-values satisfy the stated p<1e-3 with room (splicing 9.68e-07, SR/hnRNP 2.61e-04). Note the sentence's implicit contrast: the same themes tested on the TRANSCRIPTIONAL arm give OR 1.19 and 0.76, so the specificity claim holds. productive_response.Rmd::down-arm-mechanism, 2026-08-08.
- **3.5.2** — THE FOUR NUMBERS ALL REPRODUCE; THE SIGNIFICANCE CLAIM DOES NOT.
